admission.title: Eligibility & Admission Criteria (DSE)
content: **Admission Score Formula**: Best 5 subjects + 6th subject bonus. Subject weighting: Phy/ICT/Math/M1/M2 weighted.
**Highest Attainable Score**: 58.01.
**Median Admission Score**: N/A (2025 JUPAS data).
**Lower Quartile**: N/A (2025 JUPAS data).
**Preferred HKDSE Subjects**: Phy/ ICT Level 5*; Math/ M1/ M2 Level 5.
**Core Subjects Minimum Level**: Chinese Language 3, English Language 3, Mathematics (Compulsory Part) 3, Citizenship and Social Development Attained.
**Elective Subjects**: ANY 2 SUBJECTS at Level 3.
**Interview**: No interview required for standard JUPAS admission.
**Duration**: 4 years full-time.
**First Year Tuition**: HK$44,500 (local students).

curriculum.title: Curriculum Overview
content: **Programme Structure**: JS5270 offers a comprehensive four-year curriculum in Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, blending core engineering principles with cutting-edge aerospace and mechanical technologies. Students can choose from two streams: **Mechanical Engineering** and **Aerospace Engineering**.

**Year 1 – Foundation**: Students build a strong foundation in mathematics, physics, and engineering fundamentals. Core courses include **Engineering Mechanics**, **Thermodynamics**, **Materials Science**, and **Programming for Engineers**. A **Common Year** allows exploration before stream selection.

**Year 2 – Core Specialisation**: Deep dive into stream-specific subjects. Mechanical stream covers **Fluid Mechanics**, **Solid Mechanics**, **Dynamics and Control**; Aerospace stream adds **Aerodynamics**, **Propulsion**, and **Flight Mechanics**.

**Year 3 – Advanced Topics**: Students take advanced courses like **Computational Fluid Dynamics**, **Finite Element Methods**, **Robotics**, and **Spacecraft Design**. A **Capstone Design Project** begins, integrating theory with practical design.

**Year 4 – Final Year Project and Electives**: The **Final Year Project** (FYP) is a major research or design project, often in collaboration with industry. Students also choose electives from areas like **Renewable Energy**, **Mechatronics**, **Aerospace Structures**, or **Entrepreneurship**.

**Industrial Training and Internships**: All students complete a **mandatory industrial training** or internship, leveraging HKUST’s proximity to Hong Kong Science Park and strong industry links. Recent partners include **Cathay Pacific**, **MTR**, and **ASM Pacific Technology**.

career.title: Career Prospects
content: **High Demand Sector**: Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering graduates are in high demand globally. HKUST’s programme is designed to meet the needs of industries such as **aviation**, **automotive**, **energy**, **robotics**, and **manufacturing**.

**Top Employers**: Graduates secure roles at leading companies including **Cathay Pacific**, **Hong Kong Aircraft Engineering Company (HAECO)**, **MTR Corporation**, **ASM Pacific Technology**, **Schneider Electric**, and **Siemens**.

**Diverse Roles**: Typical positions include **Aerospace Engineer**, **Mechanical Design Engineer**, **Project Engineer**, **Quality Assurance Manager**, **Research and Development Specialist**, and **Technical Consultant**.

**Further Studies**: Many graduates pursue **Master’s or PhD** programmes at top global universities such as **MIT**, **Stanford**, **Cambridge**, and **ETH Zurich**. HKUST also offers advanced degrees in **Mechanical Engineering** and **Aerospace Engineering**.

**Entrepreneurship and Innovation**: HKUST’s strong entrepreneurship ecosystem, including the **HKUST Entrepreneurship Center** and **HKUST-Sino One Million Dollar Entrepreneurship Competition**, supports graduates who wish to start their own tech ventures.

**Global Opportunities**: The programme’s international recognition and HKUST’s extensive exchange network (over 300 partner universities) open doors to careers worldwide, including in **Silicon Valley**, **Singapore**, **Mainland China**, and **Europe**.

campus.title: Campus Life and Facilities
content: **Stunning Location**: HKUST is located in **Clear Water Bay, Sai Kung**, offering breathtaking sea views and a tranquil environment conducive to study. The campus is a short bus ride from central Hong Kong.

**World-Class Laboratories**: The Department houses state-of-the-art labs including the **Aerodynamics and Propulsion Laboratory**, **Materials and Mechanics Laboratory**, **Robotics and Control Laboratory**, and **Clean Energy Laboratory**.

**Student Organisations**: The **Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering Society (MAES)** organises academic, social, and career events. Students also join **HKUST Robotics Team**, **HKUST Aero Team**, and **Formula SAE Team** for hands-on experience.

**Sports and Recreation**: Facilities include an **Olympic-standard swimming pool**, **sports halls**, **fitness centres**, **tennis courts**, and **hiking trails** in the surrounding Sai Kung countryside.
**Residential Life**: All undergraduates are guaranteed on-campus accommodation for at least two years. Halls offer vibrant communities with study rooms, common rooms, and regular hall events.
**Proximity to Science Park**: HKUST is adjacent to **Hong Kong Science Park**, providing students with internship opportunities, industry projects, and access to over 1,000 tech companies.

competitiveness.title: Competitiveness and Admission
content: **Overall Level**: High (★★★★☆)
**Admission Score Formula**: Best 5 subjects + 6th subject bonus. Subjects like **Physics**, **ICT**, **Mathematics**, **M1**, and **M2** are weighted more heavily.

**Preferred HKDSE Subjects**: The programme strongly prefers **Physics** or **ICT** at Level 5*, and **Mathematics**, **M1**, or **M2** at Level 5. Meeting these preferences significantly boosts your application.
**Highest Attainable Score**: The maximum score is **58.01**, reflecting the weighted formula. Achieving this requires top grades in weighted subjects.
**Median and Lower Quartile (2025)**: Data is not yet available for 2025, but historical trends indicate strong competition. Applicants should aim for scores above **50** to be competitive.
**Selection Criteria**: Beyond HKDSE scores, HKUST considers **interview performance** (if applicable), **personal statement**, and **extracurricular achievements** in STEM-related activities.

alumni.title: Notable Alumni
content: **Dr. Charles K. Kao (高錕)**: Nobel Laureate in Physics (2009) and former HKUST Vice-Chancellor. Though not a graduate of this specific programme, his legacy inspires the engineering community at HKUST.
**Dr. Tony F. Chan (陳繁昌)**: Former President of HKUST (2009–2018) and renowned mathematician in image processing and scientific computing. He holds a PhD from Stanford.
**Dr. Nancy Ip (葉玉如)**: Renowned neuroscientist and Vice-President for Research and Development at HKUST. She is a member of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and has received numerous awards.
**Dr. Lionel M. Ni (倪明選)**: Former Vice-President for Academic Affairs at HKUST and a leading figure in computer networking and distributed systems. He is now President of the University of Macau.
**Dr. Sarah Liao (廖秀冬)**: Former Secretary for the Environment, Transport and Works of Hong Kong (2002–2007). She holds a PhD in Environmental Engineering from HKUST.
**Dr. David K. Y. Wong (王建業)**: Founder and CEO of **ASM Pacific Technology**, a global leader in semiconductor equipment. He is a strong supporter of HKUST’s engineering programmes.

scholarships.title: Scholarships and Financial Aid
content: **HKUST Entrance Scholarships**: Awarded to top HKDSE achievers. Students with scores above **50** (under the weighted formula) may receive **full tuition scholarships** or **living allowances**.

**School of Engineering Scholarships**: The School offers **Dean’s Scholarships** for outstanding students, covering partial to full tuition. Selection is based on HKDSE results and interview performance.
**Departmental Scholarships**: The Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering provides **Merit Scholarships** for students with exceptional academic performance in Year 1 and beyond.
**External Scholarships**: Students can apply for scholarships from organisations like **Hong Kong Jockey Club**, **Sir Edward Youde Memorial Fund**, and **Croucher Foundation**.
**Financial Aid**: HKUST offers **means-tested financial assistance** through the **Government’s Student Financial Assistance Agency (SFAA)** and the **HKUST Financial Aid Scheme**.
**Scholarships for Exchange**: The **Global Exchange Scholarship** supports students participating in exchange programmes, covering travel and living expenses for one semester abroad.

tips.title: Ace Sir's JS5270 Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: **1. Master the Weighted Subjects**
- Focus on **Physics/ICT** (aim for Level 5*) and **Math/M1/M2** (aim for Level 5). These subjects are weighted most heavily in the admission formula.
- Dedicate extra study time to these subjects; a single grade improvement can boost your score by 2–3 points.
**2. Target a Score Above 50**
- The highest attainable score is 58.01. Aim for at least **50 points** to be competitive. Use the HKUST admission calculator to simulate your score.
- For example, 5* in Physics (weighted 7), 5 in Math (weighted 5), and 5 in M2 (weighted 5) gives a strong base.
**3. Excel in Your Best 5 Subjects**
- The formula uses **Best 5 subjects + 6th subject bonus**. Ensure your top 5 subjects are as strong as possible, including at least two weighted subjects.
- A 6th subject at Level 4 or above can add a bonus of up to 1 point.
**4. Prepare for Interviews**
- If shortlisted, you may be invited for an interview. Practice explaining your interest in mechanical/aerospace engineering and your career goals.
- Be ready to discuss a recent engineering project or innovation you admire.
**5. Build a Strong Personal Statement**
- Highlight your passion for engineering, any STEM-related extracurriculars (e.g., robotics club, science competitions), and relevant work experience.
- Mention specific reasons for choosing HKUST, such as its labs, industry links, or exchange programmes.
**6. Gain Hands-On Experience**
- Participate in **HKUST Summer Programmes** or **STEM workshops** to demonstrate practical skills. This strengthens your application and interview responses.
- Consider joining the **HKUST Robotics Team** or **Aero Team** if you are already a student.
**7. Leverage School-Based Support**
- HKUST’s **School of Engineering** offers academic advising and career services. Use these resources to tailor your application and plan your studies.
- Attend **HKUST Open Day** or **Info Sessions** to learn more about the programme and meet professors.
**8. Explore Scholarships Early**
- Check eligibility for **HKUST Entrance Scholarships** and apply before the deadline. High-scoring students may receive full funding.
- Prepare a strong academic profile to maximise your chances of merit-based awards.
**9. Plan for a Global Career**
- Research exchange programmes and internships early. HKUST has over 300 partner universities; aim for a semester abroad in Year 3.
- Network with alumni and industry professionals through HKUST’s **Career Center** and **Alumni Association**.

admission.title: 入學要求與計分詳情 (DSE)
content: **入學計分公式**：最佳五科 + 6th subject bonus。科目比重：Phy/ICT/Math/M1/M2 加權。
**入學中位數**：N/A分（2025年聯招數據）。
**下四分位數**：N/A分（2025年聯招數據）。
**文憑試選修科平均成績**：Phy/ ICT Level 5*; Math/ M1/ M2 Level 5。
**核心科目最低要求**：中國語文第3級、英國語文第3級、數學（必修部分）第3級、公民與社會發展科達標。
**選修科目**：任何2科達第3級。
**面試**：標準聯招入學不需要面試。
**修讀年期**：4年全日制。
**首年學費**：港幣44,500元（本地學生）。

curriculum.title: 課程概覽
content: **課程結構**：JS5270 提供為期四年的機械及航空航天工程綜合課程，融合核心工程原理與尖端航空航天及機械技術。學生可選擇兩個專修：**機械工程** 和 **航空航天工程**。
**第一年 – 基礎**：學生建立數學、物理和工程基礎。核心課程包括 **工程力學**、**熱力學**、**材料科學** 和 **工程編程**。**共同一年** 讓學生在選擇專修前探索興趣。
**第二年 – 核心專業**：深入學習專修領域科目。機械專修涵蓋 **流體力學**、**固體力學**、**動力學與控制**；航空航天專修增加 **空氣動力學**、**推進力學** 和 **飛行力學**。
**第三年 – 高階課題**：學生修讀高階課程，如 **計算流體力學**、**有限元法**、**機器人學** 和 **航天器設計**。**頂石設計項目** 開始，將理論與實踐設計結合。
**第四年 – 畢業專題與選修**：**畢業專題**（FYP）是一項重要的研究或設計項目，通常與業界合作。學生還可選修 **可再生能源**、**機電一體化**、**航空航天結構** 或 **創業學** 等領域的科目。
**工業培訓與實習**：所有學生必須完成 **強制性工業培訓** 或實習，利用科大鄰近香港科學園及強大的業界聯繫。近期合作夥伴包括 **國泰航空**、**港鐵** 和 **ASM Pacific Technology**。

career.title: 就業前景
content: **高需求行業**：機械及航空航天工程畢業生全球需求極高。科大的課程專為滿足 **航空**、**汽車**、**能源**、**機器人** 和 **製造業** 等行業的需求而設計。
**頂尖僱主**：畢業生任職於領先企業，包括 **國泰航空**、**香港飛機工程公司（HAECO）**、**港鐵公司**、**ASM Pacific Technology**、**施耐德電氣** 和 **西門子**。
**多元化職位**：典型職位包括 **航空航天工程師**、**機械設計工程師**、**項目工程師**、**品質保證經理**、**研發專家** 和 **技術顧問**。
**深造機會**：許多畢業生在全球頂尖大學攻讀 **碩士或博士** 課程，如 **麻省理工學院**、**史丹福大學**、**劍橋大學** 和 **蘇黎世聯邦理工學院**。科大亦提供 **機械工程** 和 **航空航天工程** 的高等學位。
**創業與創新**：科大強大的創業生態系統，包括 **科大創業中心** 和 **科大-信和百萬獎金創業大賽**，支持希望創辦科技企業的畢業生。
**全球機會**：該課程的國際認可及科大廣泛的交換網絡（超過300所合作大學）為畢業生打開全球就業之門，包括 **矽谷**、**新加坡**、**中國內地** 和 **歐洲**。

campus.title: 校園生活與設施
content: **絕美景觀**：科大位於 **清水灣、西貢**，擁有壯麗海景和寧靜的學習環境。校園距離香港市中心僅短途巴士車程。
**世界級實驗室**：學系設有先進實驗室，包括 **空氣動力學與推進力實驗室**、**材料與力學實驗室**、**機器人與控制實驗室** 及 **清潔能源實驗室**。
**學生組織**：**機械及航空航天工程學會** 舉辦學術、社交及就業活動。學生亦可加入 **科大機械人團隊**、**科大飛行器團隊** 及 **Formula SAE 車隊** 獲取實踐經驗。
**體育與休閒**：設施包括 **奧運標準游泳池**、**體育館**、**健身中心**、**網球場** 及周邊西貢鄉郊的 **遠足徑**。
**住宿生活**：所有本科生至少保證兩年校內住宿。宿舍設有溫馨的社區，配備自修室、聯誼室及定期舉辦宿舍活動。
**毗鄰科學園**：科大毗鄰 **香港科學園**，為學生提供實習機會、行業項目及接觸超過1,000家科技公司的機會。

competitiveness.title: 競爭力與入學
content: **入學分數公式**：最佳5科 + 第6科加分。**物理**、**資訊及通訊科技**、**數學**、**M1** 及 **M2** 等科目權重更高。
**優先HKDSE科目**：課程強烈偏好 **物理** 或 **資訊及通訊科技** 達5*級，以及 **數學**、**M1** 或 **M2** 達5級。滿足這些偏好可大幅提升申請競爭力。
**最高可達分數**：最高分數為 **58.01**，反映加權公式。要在加權科目中取得頂尖成績才能達到此分數。
**2025年中位數及下四分位數**：2025年數據尚未公佈，但歷史趨勢顯示競爭激烈。申請人應爭取 **50分** 以上以提高競爭力。
**甄選標準**：除HKDSE成績外，科大亦考慮 **面試表現**（如適用）、**個人陳述** 及 **STEM相關課外活動成就**。

alumni.title: 知名校友
content: **高錕博士**：2009年諾貝爾物理學獎得主，前科大校長。雖然非本課程畢業生，但其精神啟發科大的工程社群。
**陳繁昌博士**：前科大校長（2009–2018），圖像處理及科學計算領域著名數學家，擁有史丹福大學博士學位。
**葉玉如博士**：著名神經科學家，科大副校長（研究及發展），中國科學院院士，屢獲殊榮。
**倪明選博士**：前科大副校長（學術），計算機網絡及分佈式系統領域權威，現任澳門大學校長。
**廖秀冬博士**：前香港環境運輸及工務局局長（2002–2007），持有科大環境工程博士學位。
**王建業博士**：**ASM Pacific Technology** 創辦人兼行政總裁，全球半導體設備領導者，大力支持科大工程課程。

scholarships.title: 獎學金與經濟援助
content: **科大入學獎學金**：頒予頂尖HKDSE考生。分數達 **50分** 以上（按加權公式）的學生可獲 **全額學費獎學金** 或 **生活津貼**。
**工程學院獎學金**：學院提供 **院長獎學金** 予優秀學生，涵蓋部分或全額學費。甄選基於HKDSE成績及面試表現。
**學系獎學金**：機械及航空航天工程學系為第一年及之後學業成績卓越的學生提供 **優秀獎學金**。
**校外獎學金**：學生可申請 **香港賽馬會**、**尤德爵士紀念基金** 及 **裘槎基金會** 等機構的獎學金。
**經濟援助**：科大透過 **政府學生資助處** 及 **科大經濟援助計劃** 提供經入息審查的經濟援助。
**交換生獎學金**：**全球交換獎學金** 支持參與交換計劃的學生，涵蓋一學期海外的旅費及生活費。

tips.title: Ace Sir JS5270 攻略 — 9 個實用貼士
content: **1. 掌握加權科目**
- 專注於 **物理/資訊及通訊科技**（目標5*級）和 **數學/M1/M2**（目標5級）。這些科目在入學公式中權重最高。
- 投入額外時間學習這些科目；一個等級的提升可為你的分數增加2–3分。
**2. 目標分數高於50分**
- 最高可達分數為58.01。目標至少 **50分** 以具競爭力。使用科大入學計算器模擬你的分數。
- 例如，物理5*（加權7）、數學5（加權5）、M2 5（加權5）可提供堅實基礎。
**3. 最佳5科表現優異**
- 公式使用 **最佳5科 + 第6科加分**。確保你的最佳5科盡量高分，並包括至少兩科加權科目。
- 第6科達4級或以上可獲最多1分加分。
**4. 準備面試**
- 如獲篩選，你可能被邀請參加面試。練習解釋你對機械/航空航天工程的興趣及職業目標。
- 準備討論你欣賞的近期工程項目或創新。
**5. 撰寫有力個人陳述**
- 突出你對工程的熱情、任何STEM相關課外活動（如機械人學會、科學比賽）及相關工作經驗。
- 提及選擇科大的具體原因，例如其實驗室、業界聯繫或交換計劃。
**6. 獲取實踐經驗**
- 參加 **科大暑期課程** 或 **STEM工作坊** 以展示實踐技能。這可強化你的申請及面試回應。
- 如已是學生，考慮加入 **科大機械人團隊** 或 **飛行器團隊**。
**7. 善用學院支援**
- 科大的 **工程學院** 提供學術諮詢及就業服務。利用這些資源調整你的申請及規劃學習。
- 參加 **科大開放日** 或 **資訊講座** 以了解更多課程資訊並與教授交流。
**8. 及早探索獎學金**
- 檢查 **科大入學獎學金** 的資格並在截止日期前申請。高分學生可獲全額資助。
- 建立優秀的學術檔案以最大化獲得績優獎學金的機會。
**9. 規劃全球職業生涯**
- 及早研究交換計劃及實習機會。科大擁有超過300所合作大學；目標在第三年進行一學期海外交流。
- 通過科大的 **就業中心** 及 **校友會** 與校友及業界專業人士建立網絡。
